summaries.summary: The diagram illustrates a reverse proxy system with explicit rules for a.com, b.com, and c.com. The reverse proxy receives requests from a browser (for c.com) and forwards them to one of three web sites (A, B, or C) based on the rules. Requests for other domains are typically denied.
key_facts: The reverse proxy has explicit rules for a.com, b.com, and c.com.
The browser sends a GET / HTTP/1.1 Host: c.com request to the reverse proxy.
The reverse proxy forwards the request to one of three web sites (A, B, or C).
